fichas.title: Garage and Industrial Doors
fichas.summary: Overview of garage and industrial door types, construction options, operation, and installation. Up-and-over doors may be sliding or folding and use spring counterbalance or a counterbalance weight. Other types include upward-folding, sectional, telescopic lifting, roller, drop, sliding, and folding doors. Industrial doors may be operated by pull switches, light beams, induction, or wireless remote-control contact pads.
